conversation_pain_points: bot did not simplify language when asked

main_topics.reason: The user asked whether anything can be done and repeatedly discussed possible treatments and exercise.
The user directly asked whether they would feel this way forever.
The user described pain in several areas that is worst in the mornings and asked whether it was related to fibromyalgia.
The user said they were tired all the time despite sleeping nine hours and asked whether fibromyalgia could explain it.
The user said their doctor had sent them home without offering treatment and asked how to get the options discussed.
The user repeatedly said the explanations were confusing and that they felt more confused than when they started.

output.summary: The user asked whether fibromyalgia can be treated and whether the pain would last forever, and also described morning pain and persistent fatigue.
